hunks.sol: I looked at the dozens of sheets of paper scattered across the floor.

hunks.sol: I ignored Magic Johnson’s flustered calls and the Skeleton King’s nonsense.

hunks.baseline: With my mouth pressed tightly shut, I rapidly skimmed through the stack of printed papers.
hunks.sol: My lips pressed firmly together, I rapidly skimmed through the stack of printouts.

hunks.baseline: Each sheet contained its own patterns and symbols. After examining all of them, I realized one thing.
hunks.sol: Each sheet bore a different set of patterns and symbols. By the time I had examined them all, I had realized one thing.

hunks.sol: There was no mistake. The strange patterns and symbols were identical to the ones I had seen in Murim, only arranged and oriented differently.

hunks.sol: And if I assembled all these sheets like pieces of a puzzle, they would form one enormous magic circle.

hunks.baseline: *What the hell kind of situation is this?*
hunks.sol: *What the hell is going on?*

hunks.baseline: It felt as if someone had struck the back of my head with a sledgehammer.
hunks.sol: I felt as though someone had smashed me in the back of the head with a sledgehammer.

hunks.baseline: I stared silently at the papers for a long time before finally opening my mouth.
hunks.sol: I stared silently at the papers for a long time before finally speaking.

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson had a cigar between his lips by then. When I looked at him and asked, he exhaled smoke before answering.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson had a cigar between his lips by then. He blew out a cloud of smoke before answering.

hunks.baseline: 「That’s right. I didn’t even know something like this existed at first, but it seems to have been discovered soon after the investigation team was deployed. I received it through the coalition forces on the second day.」
hunks.sol: 「That’s right. I didn’t know anything like this existed at first, but apparently it was discovered shortly after the investigation team went in. The coalition forces sent it to me on the second day.」

hunks.baseline: “You received it?”
hunks.sol: “They sent it to you?”

hunks.baseline: 「They asked for my advice. They couldn’t figure out exactly what kind of function the magic circle had, either. They probably contacted the other two as well.」
hunks.sol: 「They wanted my opinion. They couldn’t figure out exactly what the magic circle did, either. They probably contacted the other two as well.」

hunks.baseline: The other two were probably the Grand Mages besides Magic Johnson. They were the greatest mages alive and true experts in the field.
hunks.sol: The other two must have been the Grand Mages besides Magic Johnson. They were the greatest mages alive, the true experts in the field.

hunks.baseline: And that meant this magic circle was a new kind that had never been revealed before.
hunks.sol: Which meant this magic circle was something entirely new—something that had never been seen before.

hunks.baseline: “So, did you figure anything out through your research?”
hunks.sol: “So, has your research turned up anything?”

hunks.baseline: 「Not precisely yet, but I’ve gotten a general idea of the magic circle’s purpose.」
hunks.sol: 「Nothing conclusive yet, but I have a general idea of the magic circle’s purpose.」

hunks.sol: He was a native of the Demon Realm and a Named Monster to boot, so he was bound to know something.

hunks.sol: “Indeed. It seems the Arch Lich used it to absorb other humans’ energy and amass power. With all that mana at its disposal, it could control countless legions of monsters and open Gates.”

hunks.baseline: Even after suffering enormous casualties during the Great Cataclysm, it still had a population equivalent to one-fifth of the world’s total.
hunks.sol: Even after suffering staggering casualties during the Great Cataclysm, it was still home to one-fifth of the world’s population.

hunks.baseline: And the population living in Sichuan Province alone was approximately eighty million—according to official statistics, at least.
hunks.sol: And approximately eighty million people lived in Sichuan Province alone—according to the official statistics, at least.

hunks.sol: The monster wave had caused millions of casualties. Add those who had yet to be officially counted, and the number would rise to truly staggering proportions.

hunks.baseline: *And a considerable number of those people must have been sacrificed to provide mana. Considering the scale of what that bastard had done, it all adds up.*
hunks.sol: *And a great many of them must have been sacrificed to provide mana. Considering the scale of what that bastard did, it all adds up.*

hunks.baseline: “That is merely my personal inference. I cannot guarantee it.”
hunks.sol: “It is merely my personal inference. I cannot guarantee it.”

hunks.baseline: “Vile human. Can you determine the meaning of magic circles used by other humans simply by looking at them?”
hunks.sol: “Vile human. Can you tell what a magic circle created by another human does simply by looking at it?”

hunks.baseline: Just as Hunters and monsters were classified according to their individual traits, the Skeleton King possessed only that much ability.
hunks.sol: Just as Hunters and monsters were classified according to their respective traits, the Skeleton King only possessed the abilities specific to him.

hunks.baseline: His answer wasn’t what I had hoped for, and I could not help feeling deflated. But one important question remained.

hunks.baseline: “Then how did you guess that it was a life-force absorption magic circle? Can only monsters recognize patterns and symbols like these?”
hunks.sol: “Then how did you guess it was a life-force absorption circle? Can only monsters recognize patterns and symbols like these?”

hunks.sol: The formation carved into the center of the cave. The patterns and symbols in the magic circle discovered here. The bizarre phenomena I had witnessed during my battles with the Blood Lord and the Western Heaven Demon Lord…

hunks.sol: I desperately tried to deny the ominous thought that flashed through my mind.

hunks.baseline: And if it was fate, what did this connection that had appeared out of nowhere mean?
hunks.sol: And if it was fate, what did this connection that had suddenly appeared mean?

hunks.baseline: After pacing silently around the suite for a long time, I suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: After pacing silently around the suite for a long time, I abruptly spoke.

hunks.sol: “I need to see it for myself.”

hunks.sol: “What do you mean, ‘so’? I am informing you that I shall be spending the night out. Now, I must go arrange a date with the beauty… But, vile human.”
